suggestion.title: Rename and rewrite text
suggestion.rationale: The name and text described an attack; the jutsu is a self buff.

data.name: Bedrock Stance
data.description: The user roots themselves to the earth and draws its strength up through their body. For a short time they shrug off blows like bedrock and their taijutsu lands harder.
data.battleDescription: %user sinks into a low stance as the ground hardens beneath them, their body turning stone-steady and their fists heavy.

suggestion.rationale: Renamed from Earthshatter Strike: it deals no damage and only buffs the user (20% less damage taken, 20% more taijutsu damage, 2 rounds). Text rewritten to match; %target removed from the battle line, where it printed the user's own name.
